note: Embedded named presets a document reaches through `extends`. The set is deliberately small: a preset is a public compatibility surface, and every name shipped here is one that cannot be removed without a schema major. A preset carries only what it changes — the style supplies the tokens, the geometry preset supplies the long side and the byte budget, and the serializer supplies the themed-inline custom properties. Restating any of those would fork a source of truth and would make `explain` attribute the value to the preset instead of to where it comes from.

defaults.note: The weakest layer: what a document that says nothing at all resolves to. These are product choices, so they live in data rather than in Go. `card` is the default profile because the accepted site composition is many small card illustrations and one hero; `un` is the default boundary by DEC-002; `standalone` is the default delivery because an asset that needs no host CSS is the safer default for someone trying the tool for the first time; `outline` is the most neutral of the five styles and reads on any background; markers are off by REQ-7 and animation by REQ-8. Layout carries only a mode — the long side comes from the geometry preset for the resolved profile.

presets.name: site-default
presets.note: The owner's site composition: inline assets that inherit the page's colours, drawn in the style that reads at card size without competing with the text beside it.

presets.name: standalone-default
presets.note: The same asset baked rather than themed: complete presentation, no host CSS required, usable through an img tag or as a mask. A sibling of site-default rather than a child — it overrides everything site-default sets, so inheriting from it would be inheritance that does nothing.
